title: The World of Zero
html:
The galaxy was visible beyond the pitch-black window. With my forehead against the cold glass, I gazed endlessly at that dark vista.

I had no idea how much time had passed. I wanted to look back. It felt as though they would still be there if I looked back.

「Kim Dokja finally stopped crying.」

“I wasn't crying, you bastard.”

「He lied, too.」

“······How long are you going to keep narrating? The story's over now.”

The [Fourth Wall] snickered. Drawing a little strength from that laughter, I looked toward the rear windows once more.

What I wanted to see was no longer reflected there. The Earth where I had lived had receded beyond my reach.

Of course, that did not mean there was no me there.

[The 'Avatar' skill is active.]

[Your connection to the 'avatar' has been severed due to worldline separation.]

[Your avatar will continue its life through an independent ego process.]

Forty-nine percent of me.

[This avatar will be entirely beyond your control.]

He would not know he was an avatar.

He would simply live the rest of his life with the others as Kim Dokja.

「Why 4 9 per cent?」

“I tried to split it exactly fifty-fifty, but it didn't work out.”

「Why 4 9 per cent?」

The same question. I could hide nothing from the [Fourth Wall].

“You already know.”

「That was n't like you」

“No, this is just like me.”

A very 'Kim Dokja' thing to do—pathetic, immature, and selfish at the decisive moment.

「2%.」

That number was proof that I remembered the others more fully, and the lie that I was closer than the avatar to the 'Kim Dokja' they remembered.

Even if no one knew the me here, even if their stories thus came to an end······ It was a vow that I, at least, would never forget them.

「Do you re gret it?」

The faint noise of the rattling subway reached me. The empty train. Hand straps no one held swayed limply.

「Don't be lone ly」

“I'm not lonely.”

I slowly took a deep breath.

I had been in a situation like this before. It had been the same when I became the 'Demon King of Salvation' and first fell onto the Story Horizon. Perhaps things were better now than they had been then. At least I wasn't suffering any scenario-expulsion penalty now.

But if there was one difference, it was.

「Now, I can never meet the others again.」

“······Do I have to stay on this subway from now on?”

「Stay ing?」

“I'm asking whether I can go outside.”

The [Fourth Wall] was silent for a moment, as though considering what that meant, then answered.

「There is no con cept of 'entering or leaving' here.」

“What are you talking about?”

「This is the Dream Sanc tuary (聖所). Where the 'Oldest Dream' sleeps.」

Listening to it, I slowly understood.

Every worldline related to 'Ways of Survival' was a dream of the 'Oldest Dream'.

「Every world is a dream born here.」

In a flash, every subway window turned into a screen.

At first I thought they were tunnel advertisements placed along certain stretches of the subway line. Scenes of the scenarios flowed past the windows. But of course there could be no advertisements here.

Tsu-tsu-tsu-tsu-tsu······.

A dizzying headache. Scenes of worldlines scattered through the universe were flowing past.

Only then did I truly feel what kind of being I had become.

「He was the 'Oldest Dream'.」

With trembling steps, I approached a window. The screen, lightly rippling like water, looked fragile enough for me to break at any moment.

「Kim Dokja was afraid.」

No one needed to tell me.

Every 'story' in this world exists only because a reader reads it.

「If he does not watch, the world stops.」

To watch the worlds without rest. To dream.

「That was the weight borne by the 'Oldest Dream'.」

I slowly closed my eyes and opened them. I had chosen all of this.

And of course being able to see was better than seeing nothing.

Besides, I had become the ultimate constellation, able to peep into every worldline······.

“Fourth Wall.”

「What」

“The 'Oldest Dream' could act as a constellation, too. Right?”

The previous 'Oldest Dream' had sent messages as a 'constellation' in the round I lived in. Though it had been the unconscious mind of a child who knew nothing, that unconscious mind had certainly interfered with the system.

「Cor rect」

“Then making contact again as a 'constellation' with the worldline I lived in······.”

「Do you think that would be pos sible?」

“Can't I?”

「It isn't a ques tion of can or can't」

I thought about what that meant for a moment, then bit my lip hard.

“······Right. I shouldn't. I know.”

I remembered what the others and I had suffered to reach this ending.

We had fought to get rid of the constellations, to get rid of the 〈Star Stream〉 system. And we had done it.

If I brought the 〈Star Stream〉 back now······.

「For tunately you can't even if you want to right now」

“Why? I'm the 'Oldest Dream' now. Doesn't whatever I imagine come true?”

「Even the Oldest Dream can't con trol every thing」

Sparks rising lightly with a tsu-tsu-tsut.

It seemed that the current 'me' would have difficulty exerting enough influence as the 'Oldest Dream'.

「Your con trol over the dream is still insuf ficient」

······True. If it were that easy to control, it wouldn't be called a 'dream'.

Perhaps it would become possible someday, but not yet.

After biting my lip for a moment, I continued.

“Then······ what about just watching?”

At that moment, something within me stirred.

A 'me' I could not control. I felt a vast unconscious mind coiled inside me. That unconscious mind extended roots toward other worldlines and drew the worlds' stories up through those roots.

Within my darkened vision, the scenery of worldlines unfolded like a kaleidoscope.

「The scenery of the world he missed so desperately.」

In the distance, I thought I saw the lights of the [Industrial Complex]. I saw the others from behind as they headed toward it. There was no shadow on any of their faces. At the center of those people standing shoulder to shoulder was another Kim Dokja in a white coat.

I knew.

Even though I knew.

My heart pounded wildly, and my breath grew short. Gasping, I screamed. Holding back the rising nausea, I shook my head and opened my eyes.

When I braced a hand on the floor, my head spinning, I was alone on the train.

「Why? Don't you feel like look ing?」

I wanted to.

The others' happy faces. Those expressions, finally free of the hell of the scenarios.

I wanted to read the story I had wanted so desperately. But I could not watch.

If I did, I would surely want to return.

“······I have to watch, don't I? If I don't watch, the world won't move?”

「You're al ready watching」

“What?”

「Con sciousness is only a frac tion of the uncon scious. You're al ready watching most world lines」

“Then······.”

「You don't need to force your self Kim Dok ja」

With something like pity, the [Fourth Wall] continued.

「You don't have to do any thing. Your uncon scious is al ready watching」

I could simply forget everything and close my eyes. Like an innocent child without guilt, I could play in the dream. There was no reason to dwell on tragedy and be hurt again. That was what the [Fourth Wall] was saying.

「But Kim Dokja was not a child.」

“I can't do that.”

Wiping away my cold sweat, I spoke.

All those worldlines were my sins.

I had made them. I had ruined them.

“I have to watch.”

And this was the only atonement I could offer.

When I slowly stood, worldlines appeared on the windows.

The countless worldlines of 'Ways of Survival'. Someone's tragedies, born because I had read them, were on display there.

······Perhaps there was something I had to see before the others' story.

As though it knew, the [Fourth Wall] spoke.

「It will be a ve ry long night, Kim Dok ja」

It would. I smiled.

“Don't worry. I can do this. It's my favorite story. I can enjoy watching it until I die.”

「Some day you may come to hate your favor ite story」

“If that happens.”

Reaching toward the scene on the screen, I spoke.

“That will be the price I pay.”

I slowly pressed the window, leaving my fingerprint on the screen.

[The world receives your gaze.]

[A worldline gains vitality through your consciousness.]

.

.

.

When I open my eyes again, my body is floating about a handspan and a half above the floor. As though I have left my body.

Startled by the murmur, I looked around. People were crowding in. They passed through me as though they could not see me.

Faces of office workers on their way home, every one steeped in fatigue.

······This place was.

Looking around, I saw the orange Line 3 stripe. Amazingly, I was standing on a subway platform. The current time and train information appeared on an LED panel mounted on the ceiling.

[PM 6:55]

Exactly five minutes before the scenarios began.

Soon, an announcement sounded, and a train bound for Bulgwang arrived.

People boarded one by one. I wanted to stop them if I could. But stopping them would change nothing. The scenarios would begin wherever they were. All I could do was board with them and watch all those tragedies.

「And there was a face Kim Dokja knew very well.」

Train 3434 bound for Bulgwang. Car 3707.

A man was there, staring blankly out the subway window.

After looking at his face for a moment, I chuckled.

Thinking about it, of course he was here.

All these worldlines repeated through one man's regressions. Naturally, I would meet him at the beginning of the story.

「The protagonist of this world.」

Of course, Yoo Joonghyuk did not notice me at all.

He simply stared indifferently out of the train, lost in thought. A calm face despite knowing the scenarios would soon begin. Watching him, I could not help admiring him.

······You really are incredible.

Even after seeing the scenarios' end, merely returning to this scene made me tremble. You must have endured this moment dozens, hundreds of times.

The stopped train moved, and time began to pass. If things went as I knew them, 'it' would begin soon.

「In the third round, Yoo Joonghyuk begins by killing everyone in his car.」

I recalled the beginning of the third round I knew. Whatever round this was, the beginning would not be very different. Slowly observing my surroundings, I noticed a man acting suspiciously near the doors.

“Hh, hhh······.”

At his intermittent groans, a few people turned toward him. His face contorted, the man grinned and looked around, then pulled out the homemade bomb and lighter he had hidden inside his clothes.

「On the day the paid service began, someone else had boarded car 3707 with Yoo Joonghyuk.」

“···What's that?”

“Hey, you!”

「The subway terrorist, Choi Hangyu.」

Startled people screamed and backed away. As sparks flicked from the man's hand, frightened passengers rose, and chaos spread.

And Yoo Joonghyuk simply watched him.

Hey, what are you doing? Hurry up and take that away.

According to the plot I knew, Yoo Joonghyuk should have subdued Choi Hangyu and taken his bomb the moment he boarded. But he did not.

For some reason, the face I had thought calm had gone white.

It was then that the train screeched and went dark.

As people watched the sparks flare in the darkness, their screams became cries of anguish.

Something was going wrong.

「Why isn't Yoo Joonghyuk moving?」

Wait. Could this be―

[PM 7:00]

With a click, the world's laws were changing.

[The free service for planetary system 8612 has ended.]

[The main scenario has begun.]

The terrorist's bright flame illuminated Yoo Joonghyuk's pale face. Pupils wavering with fear. Yoo Joonghyuk still stood frozen, unable to do anything. I was just as bewildered. Pages of Ways of Survival began turning in my head.

······What round was this?

When he lost it in the nine hundreds? Or the twelve hundreds?

In what round had there been a Yoo Joonghyuk this dazed―

[Channel #BI-7623 has opened.]

[Constellations (星座) are entering.]

“Hh, heh, hhhh······!”

At the sight of the terrorist glaring around with the bomb in hand, people began running toward the other cars.

[A very small number of constellations take an interest in the incarnation 'Choi Hangyu'.]

And Yoo Joonghyuk still did nothing. The Yoo Joonghyuk I knew would never act like this. Yoo Joonghyuk was the man who took control of a situation with perfect showmanship from the start. Yet faced with the terrorist's threat, he wore a stupid expression I had never seen.

Never seen······. Never······?

It felt as though lightning struck my mind.

So that was it. This story was.

Countless pages turned backward in my head, and then the book closed.

A round shown only in flashbacks, even in 'Ways of Survival'.

Some stories began where nothing had been written.

“S-save······ Please save me!”

“Aaaaaaah!”

「This story was the unknown beginning of 'Ways of Survival'.」

This worldline was Yoo Joonghyuk's zeroth round, which I had never read.

===

Yoo Joonghyuk was looking at a portal-site article the man beside him had opened.

―Pro gamer Yoo Joonghyuk: How long will he remain in hiding?

Discord within the team, the coach's abuse of power. Several circumstances unknown to others crossed his mind at once. But years had passed, and thinking about it would give him no answer.

―We found the home address.

A text message on his smartphone. News that the detective agency he had recently hired had found his parents. That was why he had ventured outside for the first time in a while.

Yoo Joonghyuk wanted to know his origins. Who had given birth to him? Who had abandoned him? Who had left a younger sister in his care while his career was thriving?

Yoo Joonghyuk desperately wanted to know.

―Huh? Did those people ever live here?

―Bah, I don't know either. That was ages ago.

He had paid the agency an enormous sum, but all he received was the address of an empty house. They said there was nothing more they could find.

His parents, who had vanished as though evaporating from this world. How could that happen?

With no memories of his parents, no proper childhood recollections, twenty-eight-year-old Yoo Joonghyuk existed alone.

As though he had been formed as an adult from birth.

In the rattling Line 3 train, Yoo Joonghyuk faced a philosophical question for the first time.

'Who······ am I?'

That was why Yoo Joonghyuk could not act immediately.

“Hhhh······!”

“Aaaaaaaah!”

Only a little later did he notice the commotion.

A large man with a scruffy beard. A homemade bomb in his hand, the clicking striker wheel of a lighter. Only after someone bumped into his shoulder as they passed did Yoo Joonghyuk grasp this unreal situation.

「Terrorism」.

The train went dark the very next moment. It stopped abruptly, and darkness filled the surroundings.

Yoo Joonghyuk felt the fine hairs on his arms rise. His mind spun. Terrorism? Was a terrorist attack, something he had only heard about, really happening in Korea? Where could he flee to? Should he call the police? Or―

[Now, everyone. A pleasure to meet you.]

Those concerns quietly vanished with the small mass of CGI that appeared in midair.

[Repeating this greeting every time is getting tiring······ Now, this is neither a film shoot nor a terrorist incident······ Huh?]

The creatures that would later introduce themselves as 'dokkaebis'.

From midair, that unknown being was laughing heartily at the scene inside the train.

[What's this? Hahahaha! Constellations-nim, look here! The scenario hasn't even arrived, and something fun is already happening!]

The dokkaebi laughed in a languid, cruel voice.

[I have high hopes for this car. Please show us an entertaining story.]

[The main scenario has arrived.]

+

〈Main Scenario # 1 ―Proof of Value〉

Category: Main

Difficulty: F

Clear condition: Kill one or more living things.

Time limit: 30 minutes

Reward: 300 coins

Failure: Death

+

And hell began.

*

······That bastard Bihyung was kind of cute back then. He had been like this once.

Listening to the screams inside the train, I found myself lost in ill-timed nostalgia.

「Are you saying you want to enter into a 〈Stream Contract〉 with me now?」

The day we first met and signed an exclusive contract felt like yesterday.

I had been so lucky then. If the contract had failed······.

「“Kim Dokja. You and I are not companions.”」

Bihyung would not have died that day.

「“I wanted to see your Story through to the end.”」

Perhaps this pain was what the trembling 'Yoo Joonghyuk' over there would feel through the thousand-plus regressions awaiting him.

“······Scenario? What the hell is this?”

The people in car 3707, who had received the first scenario, were murmuring.

Brawls from other regions played on a panel in midair. A scenario where they would die unless they killed one another.

“A g-game······ This is a game!”

The terrorist Choi Hangyu was shouting.

“Hahahahaha!”

The subway terrorist, Choi Hangyu. Information about him had once appeared in Yoo Joonghyuk's recollections in 'Ways of Survival'.

「If Choi Hangyu survives, he will later evolve into the 'Explosive Killing Fiend'.」

Taking a hammer from his waist, Choi Hangyu struck the middle-aged man beside him in the back of the head. The middle-aged man, his knees buckling helplessly.

“I-if I do this······.”

[The incarnation 'Choi Hangyu' has earned the 'First Kill' achievement!]

Watching the coins pour down before him, Choi Hangyu was awakening.

As always, the ones who adapted fastest to the 〈Star Stream〉 were the misfits of the real world.

“D-did everyone see? J-just now, I.”

“Aaaaaah! Murder! It's murder!”

Watching the people recoil in horror, Choi Hangyu tilted his head.

“W-why are you all j-just standing there? It m-makes me look like the o-only weird one.”

“Stay away!”

“D-do you maybe n-need this?”

He grinned at them, then threw them the tools hanging at his waist. Once again, he swung a spanner and drove it repeatedly into the already-dead man's back.

“I-it's easy. L-like this. If you do this.”

Blood gushed from the man's back.

“Everyone g-gets rich.”

The timer in midair was ticking down.

[The remaining time has decreased.]

[Time remaining: 10 minutes.]

Yoo Joonghyuk gazed down at the spanner that had rolled to his feet.

Still, the people showed no sign of moving.

Choi Hangyu stood up, shaking his head as though he found them pathetic.

“Sh-should I just k-kill everyone for you?”

Then a man reached out quickly and grabbed the hammer Choi Hangyu had thrown.

“F-fuck······ I don't know anymore!”

“Ajusshi! What are you doing?”

Gripping the spanner Choi Hangyu had thrown, the man began striking the people beside him indiscriminately.

「This was the scene in car 3707, where Yoo Joonghyuk had survived.」

“I-I'm sorry. I'm sorry······!”

“Aaaaaaaah!”

Amid the hollow voices, people were coming to understand reality. They did not know what was happening. But one thing was certain.

「Kill one another, or die.」

[A very small number of constellations are satisfied with the scene in this car!]

[A very small number of constellations show interest in the incarnation 'Choi Hangyu'.]

[A constellation who has not revealed their modifier sponsors the incarnation 'Choi Hangyu' with 100 coins.]

Choi Hangyu, smiling at the people in satisfaction.

And beside him, I was watching it all.

「Kim Dok ja」

I slowly withdrew my hand from the back of Choi Hangyu's neck.

'······I know. Don't worry.'

I must not change this story.

All of this had 'already happened'.

I looked at Yoo Joonghyuk. Bending down, he picked up the spanner that had fallen from Choi Hangyu's clothes.

The anguish on his face was plain.

The face of someone who had decided to kill.

But for some reason, it wasn't the expression of the Yoo Joonghyuk I knew. The Yoo Joonghyuk I knew trembled with fury at betrayal. Yoo Joonghyuk, who did not trust easily or readily make companions. Yoo Joonghyuk, who always sought the best path and did not hesitate to kill people beforehand if they would betray him anyway.

「That was why the third-round Yoo Joonghyuk could slaughter everyone in his car without hesitation.」

But the Yoo Joonghyuk before me was not in his third round.

Not the fourth, the fifth, or the 1,863rd.

「He was in the zeroth round.」

The zeroth-round Yoo Joonghyuk.

His feet began running. Feet that could not yet use [Red Phoenix Shunpo] or [Way of the Wind].

There were plenty of targets. A university student lying on the floor and trembling. A middle-aged person hiding beside the priority seats. An office worker too busy attacking someone to look behind them.

Yoo Joonghyuk ran past them all. And

「He chose the most formidable enemy in the car as his target.」

“Heh······ Huh?”

Seeing the spanner coming at him, Choi Hangyu gave a vicious grin. He stepped back lightly, and a sharp survival knife flashed from his waist. With a swish, Yoo Joonghyuk narrowly evaded the blade.

「Why did Yoo Joonghyuk make that choice?」

I did not know. Why someone so frightened would make that choice.

Choi Hangyu still had several tools, and even a homemade bomb. All Yoo Joonghyuk had was a spanner the size of a child's forearm.

Even so, I did not worry.

I did not know the zeroth round's details, but Yoo Joonghyuk would not die here.

Until he had suffered every tragedy, until he finally entered that unfathomable cycle of regression, Yoo Joonghyuk······ would not die.

[The incarnation 'Yoo Joonghyuk' awakens the attribute 'Pro Gamer'!]

His exclusive attribute was awakening. An attribute I knew well.

A skill that assessed everything in this world by quantifying it like a game. A skill that let him control his body as though moving a game avatar.

Yoo Joonghyuk's spanner struck Choi Hangyu's wrist. Choi Hangyu let out a short scream, and the homemade bomb tumbled out of his clothes.

Yoo Joonghyuk's spanner moved toward the flustered Choi Hangyu's neck.

An unavoidable blow. A perfect counterattack, calculated through Yoo Joonghyuk's talent.

But there was one thing even he had failed to calculate.

[The incarnation 'Choi Hangyu' invests 900 coins in 'Constitution'!]

The system of this new world.

“Th-that hurt.”

A dark red mark remained on Choi Hangyu's neck, but it had not broken.

With his muscles swelling, Choi Hangyu seized Yoo Joonghyuk by the nape of the neck. Yoo Joonghyuk went deathly pale as his body dangled in midair.

Holding him by the collar, Choi Hangyu drew a hammer with his other hand.

“D-die.”

At that moment, Yoo Joonghyuk looked at the 'homemade bomb' on the floor.

I realized what he was thinking.

Yoo Joonghyuk threw the spanner in his hand almost at the same moment I moved.

Time passed very slowly.

The spanner moved slowly through the air, heading straight for the center of the homemade bomb.

I watched it quietly.

Even if the bomb exploded, Yoo Joonghyuk would not die. If what I had read was right, that would surely be true. Then why.

······Why was my hand shaking so badly?

'Fourth Wall.'

A tsu-tsu-tsut sounded in midair. I continued.

'Does Yoo Joonghyuk's sponsor exist in this world?'

「They ex ist」

The 'Oldest Dream' existed in this world.

Someone who had become the 'Oldest Dream' long before me. My younger self. Or something presumed to be 'my younger self'.

'Then why can't I feel anything?'

That was what was strange.

I could feel everything in this world. Everything in the scenarios. From a single incarnation to every constellation covering the sky.

Yet there was one thing I could not feel.

'Where is the Oldest Dream now?'

The [Fourth Wall] did not answer.

Yoo Joonghyuk's spinning spanner was now just short of the homemade bomb.

'Don't tell me······.'

「How had the 'Oldest Dream' been able to make a contract with the zeroth-round Yoo Joonghyuk?」

The questions I had accumulated were exploding in my head.

「The 'Oldest Dream' dreams through 'Ways of Survival'.」

As a child, I had read 'Ways of Survival' and imagined this world.

「And 'Ways of Survival' was a story that began in Yoo Joonghyuk's third round.」

Could that child have properly imagined the zeroth round of 'Ways of Survival'?

Could he have pictured a story absent from the original, a world he had never read?

「Then who was the 'sponsor' who appeared in Yoo Joonghyuk's zeroth round?」

The bomb exploded. Flying fragments embedded themselves in Choi Hangyu's back and the bodies of people hacking at one another. The train's ceiling was collapsing with a roar. Some fragments flew straight for Yoo Joonghyuk's heart and neck.

Tsu-tsu-tsu-tsu-tsut!

[You are the owner of the 'Final Wall'.]

[Your 'control' is insufficient to interfere with this worldline.]

[The worldline's probability resists you!]

Ignoring probability, I seized the flying fragments. Fierce heat enveloped my fingertips, and the fragments crumbled in my hand.

[A Deus Ex Machina unknown to this worldline is activating!]

[The world has noticed your interference!]

「At that moment, Yoo Joonghyuk raised his head.」

Having crawled out from beneath the fallen Choi Hangyu, Yoo Joonghyuk was looking at me.

「Only for a moment, Yoo Joonghyuk felt as though someone stood before him.」

“Who······?”

[Main Scenario #1 – Proof of Value has ended.]

[You have received 300 coins as the basic clear reward.]

[100 coins have been deducted as the channel usage fee.]

[Additional reward calculation begins.]

As the scenario's results were tallied, people's heads exploded. Amid the flying blood, I silently looked down at Yoo Joonghyuk.

From far away came Bihyung's excited voice and the [Fourth Wall]'s warning. I heard messages from constellations questioning probability, too.

And Yoo Joonghyuk stared at the message before him, his gaze wavering.

['Sponsor Selection' begins!]

+

〈Sponsor (背後) Selection〉

―Choose your sponsor.

―Your chosen sponsor will become a dependable supporter.

1. God of Wine and Ecstasy

2. Nail-Eating Rat

3. Abyssal Black Flame Dragon

+

[A new constellation has entered the channel!]

[A new constellation joins 'Sponsor Selection'!]

+

1. Demon King of Salvation

+

===

[An 'Overwrite Restriction' is currently imposed on this round.]

[The copyright holder of this worldline is currently absent.]

[As owner of the 'Final Wall', you may act on the copyright holder's behalf.]

[Will you execute 'Overwrite' to interfere with the world's setting?]

Warning messages that appeared in midair all at once.

The [Fourth Wall]'s voice, sounding almost simultaneously.

「Kim Dok ja」

'······I know. Stop saying my name so ominously.'

I already knew what the [Fourth Wall] would say.

It would go on again about how there was no point changing the predetermined past.

「······.」

I could feel it glaring at me from midair, but did my best to ignore it.

I did not know exactly how the original zeroth round had unfolded. But if the passage I had glimpsed in the [Fourth Wall]'s library was true······ Yoo Joonghyuk had no sponsor until late in that round.

In this round, he would lose Lee Seolhwa, and lose Lee Jihye.

Lose the precious people he had barely managed to meet.

And faced with approaching death, he would desperately think.

「'What if I, too, had had a 'sponsor'?'」

I watched Yoo Joonghyuk read the system messages with an unsteady gaze.

Through this round, his regressions would begin.

He would regress countless times and walk through the 'Hell of Eternity'.

「E ven if you al ter this round······.」

'The past the Secretive Plotter lived through won't disappear. I know.'

Even if I changed this worldline, the tragedies to come would not disappear.

The Yoo Joonghyuk I knew would live the first, second, third, and then the 1,863rd round.

He would become the 'Secretive Plotter'. He would hate me.

But even if that came to pass.

'I can't feel any trace of an Oldest Dream other than me in this round.'

That was probably because my younger self had not known about Yoo Joonghyuk's zeroth round.

In any case, one thing was certain. At least within this worldline, I could take that child's place.

I could become Yoo Joonghyuk's sponsor in this worldline.

「Will you make him re gress?」

The [Fourth Wall] asked with apparent interest. I shook my head.

'No. I'm going to make sure he doesn't regress.'

「Even if you change him the fu ture―」

'Right. That's why I'm even more relieved.'

The past I changed would not negate the Yoo Joonghyuk I knew.

「If, at least once, Yoo Joonghyuk could have a round that wasn't unhappy.」

I slowly reached into the air.

['Overwrite' is executing!]

[Interference with this world's setting begins!]

[Your control over the dream is insufficient for active interference.]

Sparks leaped up with a tsu-tsu-tsu-tsut, and messages appeared one after another.

['Demon King of Salvation' is registered as your temporary constellation name.]

[You are currently participating in 'Sponsor Selection' as a constellation.]

[The 〈Star Stream〉 system questions your eligibility.]

[Low-grade dokkaebi 'Bihyung' finds your modifier unfamiliar.]

[A small number of constellations are bewildered by your appearance!]

Watching Yoo Joonghyuk's pale face, I bit my lip hard.

Perhaps this was the wrong choice.

Changing this worldline might make him even unhappier.
